arleen-bocatija-rojas.text: Sits on the council that voted unanimously (Apr 2026) to adopt the development agreement for a 1,115-unit mixed-use project (764 apartments, 351 townhomes) on the former Imperial Avalon mobilehome park site.

arleen-bocatija-rojas.text: Her city council page lists achievements including creating a Public Safety Task Force and re-activating the Safety First Act Now (S.F.A.N.) program.
